text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Good morning, Trainer-san. Thank you for 
giving me some time off~.
choice_data_list: Were you able to take it easy?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Yes. But getting too relaxed wouldn't do 
any good, so I made sure to get a moderate 
amount of exercise too.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
—As the saying goes, "In times of safety, 
prepare for danger."

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"It's precisely on days off that we should 
think about how to use our time 
meaningfully, after all♪"

Grass Wonder seemed to have spent her day 
off with a healthy sense of focus.
